title: Rav Nachman bar Kohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Nachman bar Kohen. (A fourth-generation Palestinian Amora.) Chullin 5a has Rav Nachman bar Kohen reporting Rabbi Assi, according to Shitah Mekubbetzet and Dikdukei Soferim. Our reading, Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak, is an evident error.

In Ketubot 105b and Sanhedrin 7b, Rav Nachman bar Kohen expounds: “A judge who is like a king, needing nothing, establishes the land,” etc. Kiddushin 33b preserves his ruling that riding counts as walking. In the Dikdukei Soferim reading of Bava Batra 8b, he expounds the verse “They shall take the gold.”

notes.text: הפסיק in the supplied text is understood as הפסוק, the verse, in the quotation formula. Bava Batra 8b supplies “They shall take the gold.” Hyman attributes his name reading to Dikdukei Soferim; it is not silently imposed on the checked text.

The named Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak–Rabbi Assi chain occurs in the consulted Davidson Chullin 5b, while Hyman supplies 5a and advocates bar Kohen. The consulted Bava Batra 8b has unqualified Rav Nachman. Hyman’s evident-error judgment, fourth-generation placement and exact Shitah Mekubbetzet/Dikdukei Soferim readings remain attributed; the locators and names are not harmonized.
